snippet.title: Nine Realms - Official Early Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description: Rule the god of thunder and challenge all the gods of the nine realms! In this Rogue-like, hack and slash game, develop your strategy and skills, subject all the gods who challenge you to your wrath, and become the only god of the universe.
